#HappyBirthdayAmerica, #America250, #MostPatrioticCarCruise, #SupportLocalBusinesses

name: 4th of July Celebration
description: Come celebrate 4th of July with us at the Murphys Hotel! Enjoy food, drinks, magic, music & Safe N Sane fireworks. Join us for the Annual 4th of July Parade at noon.

name: 4th of July Celebration at the Murphys Historic Hotel
description: The Murphys Historic Hotel throws the town's big Fourth of July bash in the parking lot off Main Street. Star Dogs play live, Kevin Axtell works the crowd with magic, fire, and juggling, and there's BBQ and cold drinks to keep everyone going. Glow necklaces and sparklers for the kids, then Safe N Sane fireworks once it gets dark. Free to come, all ages, and it caps a day that kicks off with the noon parade right out front. Celebrating 250 years, 1776 to 2026.

name: Murphys Creek Theatre
description: What the Constitution Means to Me By Heidi Schreck Fifteen-year-old Heidi once paid for college by winning Constitutional debate competitions. As an adult, she revisits that teenage self to explore how this founding document has shaped four generations of women in her family — and continues to shape all of us. Hilarious, endearing, and deeply personal, this Pulitzer Prize finalist arrives in Murphys as the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary. “Uproariously funny, wrenchingly moving, and inspiring.” — NY Review of Books Suggested for ages 12+, Content note: Personal stories involving rights, identity, and bodily autonomy. Pay-What-You-Can at every performance SUBSCRIPTIONS & FLEX PASSES Total flexibility. Bring a date. Bring a friend. Bring both. Tickets & details – https://www.murphyscreektheatre.org/what-the-constitution-means-to-me?

description: A weekend-evening campfire program. Topics and start time vary, so check the black sandwich board by the Visitor Center. Saturday campfires are skipped on Night Skies nights. Meet at the Campfire Center by the Visitor Center. Free with the $10/vehicle park entrance.

name: Introduction to North Grove @ Big Trees State Park
description: Short on time? A brief, half-mile introduction to the giant sequoias with a park interpreter. Meet outside the Visitor Center. Free with the $10/vehicle park entrance.

name: Junior Rangers @ Big Trees State Park
description: Drop-in programs for kids: Little Rangers (ages 3 to 6) and Junior Rangers (ages 7 to 12) earn wooden badges and work through their logbooks with a park interpreter. Meet at the picnic tables across from Jack Knight Hall. Free with the $10/vehicle park entrance.

name: North Grove Guided Walk @ Big Trees State Park
description: A relaxed, interpreter-led loop through the giant sequoias of the North Grove, about 1.7 level miles. Meet at the trailhead by the Visitor Center. Free with the $10/vehicle park entrance.

name: South Grove Guided Hike @ Big Trees State Park
description: A moderate five-mile hike to the park's larger, quieter grove of giant sequoias. Bring water and a snack or lunch; there is no food or water at the trailhead. Meet at the South Grove trailhead parking lot. Free with the $10/vehicle park entrance.

name: Lackler Ceramics – Kids Clay
description: 1.5 hour class focusing on basic pottery skills to make fun projects from scratch and paint them! No experience required. All materials included. For new students and students under 6- a parent/guardian should plan to stay for the duration of the class unless you make prior arrangements with Katie or the instructor. These are family friendly classes. The general age range is 5+, however parents and siblings can participate as well, under their own registration. All projects can be scaled up or simplified 🙂 All classes are $47 (online) or $45 (zelle/cash/check) per class and take place from 3-4:30pm unless otherwise noted.

name: Lackler Ceramics – Making Smalls
description: Clay makes the possibilities endless! Think small flat dishes, bowls, pinched tea cups, tiny sculptures, wind chimes, bud vases 😀 Get your sweetie, your bestie, your sibling, or just bring yourself and take some time to unplug and be creative. Come with a shape in mind, or allow the clay to surprise you. You can make several pieces in this workshop. Instructor, Lydia Scheller will guide you through making and painting your pieces. Please allow 2-8 weeks for your piece to be fired. I will message you when you can come pick it up. I am happy to ship for an additional fee. Online price: $47 Zelle, cash or check: $45 Zelle is Lackler Ceramics, Katielackler.art@gmail.com

name: Live Like Lilly Fundraising Dinner
address: 2465 Gun Club Road, Angels Camp, CA 95222
description: Join us for a special evening in memory of Lilly Butler, celebrating her spirit and passion for the rodeo community. This memorable night will bring friends, family and supporters together for dinner, dancing, and fundraising to support a meaningful cause. Guest will enjoy a delicious dinner catered by Up Country Catering, followed by an exciting evening featuring a silent auction, live auction, raffle prizes and GUN RAFFLE and DANCING! Proceeds from the event will go towards scholarship supporting young ladies who aspire to become rodeo queens as well as those currently holding a rodeo queen title. These scholarships help empower young women to pursue their goals while continuing the tradition, leadership, and horsemanship that rodeo queens represent. Get Tickets

description: Join us on Historic Main Street in Murphys to celebrate all the magic in the world. We’ll be hosting Witches, Wizards, Faeries, and other magical beings along with craft vendors, dancers, jugglers, roaming magicians, live music, a scavenger hunt, and more. Of course, all of our shops, restaurants, and tasting rooms will be open. You will be an important part of the day so come dressed as your favorite magical self and spend the day with us. This is a family-friendly event so please bring the kids, grandkids, and those who are kids at heart. We’ll have treats for them at our information booth at the corner of Church & Main.
